summary.text: Central Heaven Gate is named on Limitless Demon Venerable's left path through Heavenly Court.

claims.text: Fairy Zi Wei recalls that Limitless Demon Venerable created the left path, and that this path passes Central Heaven Gate, then Name Plaque Palace, Sun Palace, Five Deity Hall, Central Great Hall, Heaven Overseeing Tower, Forgotten Dao Lake, and Imperfection Regret Pavilion on the peak of Star Zone Mountain.

Calamity Luck Altar arrives at Central Heaven Gate. This huge gate is like a mountain adorned with beautiful golden ornaments. It is held by tall and thick pillars. There are shining pearls and gems on its frame. Five Elements Grandmaster looks at it and ponders that it looks like an information path Immortal Gu House. Bull Demon says Heavenly Court only recruits new members who are elites of the ten great ancient sects, and that these rank eight elites have to pass the test in Central Heaven Gate before they join Heavenly Court. The gate is shut tight and blocks Calamity Luck Altar.

Duke Long names Central Heaven Gate a rank eight information path Immortal Gu House with weak defenses that cannot stop Longevity Heaven for long. Golden pearls from storage are poured out to help it defend. The pearls turn into huge armored soldiers with piercing golden light under their helmets. Calamity Luck Altar crashes into Central Heaven Gate, and the gate starts to crack. After Bull Demon pushes the golden pearl soldiers away, Calamity Luck Altar breaks through. Longevity Heaven does not attack the heavily damaged Central Heaven Gate further, and only pushes forward. Sun Palace’s defense is even lower than Central Heaven Gate’s.
A million years earlier, when Limitless Demon Venerable attacked Heavenly Court, Central Heaven Gate broke into shrapnel.

Heavenly Court decides to build Central Heaven Gate. Wu Shuai offers to contribute Dragon Palace. Duke Long is happy that Wu Shuai is willing, but says Central Heaven Gate is an information path Immortal Gu House, while Dragon Palace is enslavement path, so it is not appropriate, and Heavenly Court does not need Wu Shuai to spend his own wealth. Duke Long then puts Wu Shuai and his father in charge of building Central Heaven Gate.

Gu Liang tells Wu Shuai that Central Heaven Gate can connect to grotto-heavens, and that they can leave a backdoor while probing Heavenly Court. Creating that backdoor is not easy under Heavenly Court’s supervision. Wu Shuai’s father later says he purposely failed in constructing Central Heaven Gate, suffered intense backlash, and used that excuse to escape Heavenly Court.

Wu Shuai’s father is said to have died from the backlash of failing to build Central Heaven Gate, his soul completely erased. Wu Shuai continues the work. He not only builds Central Heaven Gate, he makes his backdoor without Heavenly Court noticing it, even when they checked.
Nine Spiritual Fairy and Red Heart Traveler leave Central Heaven Gate, entering white heaven and going towards Western Desert.

Fairy Zi Wei opens Central Heaven Gate. This Immortal Gu House is the gateway to Heavenly Court. It has the ability to transport people, but it is far inferior to the enormous teleportation Gu formation and is only for convenience.

Qin Ding Ling later wants to send members of the ten great ancient sects to fight, but Central Heaven Gate of Heavenly Court, which could deploy members, was destroyed by Fairy Zi Wei during the fate war.
